allow_upload_offline_payment_receipts: Enable upload of offline payment receipts
enable_online_payment_option_desc: When set to "Yes", users will have an option to submit payment online.
enable_pay_later_option_desc: When set to "Yes", users will have an option to submit payment offline (e.g. mail in a check, call in a credit card, etc.).
include_online_meeting_url_in_email: Include online meeting URL in registration confirmation email sent to participants with pending transaction status
note_editing_payment_status: When set to "No", edit access to this field is granted to program organizers, teachers, and center admins.
pay_later_instructions_confirmation: Instructions added to Confirmation and Thank-you pages when the user selects the 'pay later' option (e.g. 'Mail your check to ... within 3 business days.')
pay_later_label_description: Text displayed next to the checkbox for the 'pay later' option on the contribution form.
restrict_editing_offline_payment_status: Restrict editing of payment status for 'offline bank transfer' transactions to National Admin and Finance Admin only
show_offline_payment_methods_assisted: Check this box to show offline payment methods as an option on the Assisted registration page.
